lens: D - Crowdfunding not yet in EU retail
slice: D5 - small tools, storage, organisation, travel gear, hardware-free gadgets

ideas.name: Felt Gridfinity-fit drawer bins
ideas.concept: Die-cut recycled-PET felt bins/trays sized to the 42 mm Gridfinity grid, flat-packed with a printed baseplate liner, for desk drawers and workshops.
ideas.target_customer: Makers, 3D-printer owners, desk/drawer organisers in SE/DK, 25-45
ideas.problem_solved: Gridfinity needs a 3D printer and hours of print time; non-printers have no ready, tidy option.
ideas.trend_evidence: Exploding Topics lists gridfinity at ~60.5K monthly searches, 'Exploding' growth (timeframe unverified). Gridfinity-compatible Kickstarters seen: Vault, Vaikin Box 3D, Mojibake chests (EUR 33k from 393 backers, Mar-Apr 2026). I did not verify EU retail availability of felt versions.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Gridfinity is an open standard, so defence is design/brand: registered community design, colourways, curated kits; weak against copycats.
ideas.tooling_needed: Steel-rule cutting dies, low hundreds EUR

ideas.name: Steel magnetic wall-rail tool storage
ideas.concept: Powder-coated laser-cut steel rail with magnetic holders for sockets, bits, hand tools and desk gear; Nordic-styled, tool-free mounting, expandable.
ideas.target_customer: DIY/home-workshop and renovation owners, SE/DK homeowners
ideas.problem_solved: Pegboard looks messy and tools get lost in drawers; magnetic rails are plain and not designed for small homes.
ideas.trend_evidence: Magnetic organiser campaigns keep appearing (Momentum Tools magnetic socket holder, MagmoFlex, Desk Engine at USD 5.6k vs 2k goal, Apr 2026). Funding of the wall-rail category specifically not verified; stage is a judgement.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Founders' building-trade fit: mounting system for plasterboard/tiles/window reveals, bundled design patent; add-on module ecosystem drives repeat.
ideas.est_landed_cost_eur: 8-12 (estimate, laser-cut and bent steel plus magnets)
ideas.tooling_needed: None (laser cut/press brake); magnets need REACH/CE check

ideas.name: Refillable pocket notebook with magnetic cover
ideas.concept: Slim notebook cover with magnet-closed pen/card holder and paper refills (FSC, dot grid, A6-ish) in a subscription-free refill pack.
ideas.problem_solved: Pocket notebooks fall apart and lack a place for pen/cards; refills are not stocked locally.
ideas.trend_evidence: HEYfold Mini shows USD 52,558 pledged vs 5,000 goal, 527 backers (year not verified from the listing). Reusable-notebook space already has incumbents, so stage is judgemental.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Refill format owned by brand (proprietary size/binding) creates repeat purchase and lock-in; design-led.

ideas.name: Nordic flat travel document pouch
ideas.concept: Slim sewn pouch holding passport, boarding pass, cards and phone, with EU/Interrail/ferry-ticket sizing and a clear RFID-free flip panel.
ideas.target_customer: Frequent flyers and rail travellers, SE/DK, 28-55
ideas.problem_solved: Documents and phone juggled at gates; existing pouches are oversized or US-sized.
ideas.trend_evidence: Several 2026 travel-pouch campaigns: DUVA FlipSide Travel Pouch (Kickstarter, press release 21 May 2026), Havo Flight Pouch and InkCase (USD 13.7k vs 3k goal) on Pledgebox/BackerKit. No funding totals verified for DUVA or Havo; crowded category.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Weak: only brand, materials and EU-fit sizing; must pair with a distinctive recycled textile and local airline/rail partnerships.

ideas.name: Laser-cut wood TTRPG/dice storage chests
ideas.concept: Birch-ply stackable chests in Nordic mythology themes, grid-compatible inserts for dice, cards and minis; add-on insert refills.
ideas.target_customer: Tabletop RPG and board-game players, SE/DK/EU, 22-45
ideas.problem_solved: Dice, cards and minis scatter; premium storage mostly sold by US/UK crowdfunders.
ideas.trend_evidence: Mojibake Gridfinity-compatible chests: EUR 33,121 raised vs EUR 2,000 goal, 393 backers, 31 Mar-21 Apr 2026 (BackerKit page snapshot). Shipping to EU retail not verified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Original Nordic artwork/IP and community collabs on Gamefound; modular insert ecosystem; hard to copy theme.
ideas.tooling_needed: None (laser cut); EN 71 check for toy-adjacent use

ideas.name: Expandable gap-storage steel rack
ideas.concept: Telescopic stainless/powder-coated rack that fits narrow gaps (10-25 cm) by sinks, fridges and wardrobes, packed flat.
ideas.problem_solved: Dead space beside appliances and in tiny kitchens/bathrooms goes unused.
ideas.trend_evidence: Only signal: a Makuake gap-storage rack reportedly at 1414% of goal (source site looks AI-generated, unverified). Treat as hypothesis needing Amazon/Google Trends check.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Telescopic mechanism design patent, plus fit-to-IKEA/Nordic appliance widths; risk of Asian lookalikes is high.
ideas.tooling_needed: Possibly stamping dies; keep under EUR 2k or reject
